using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Cthangover.Core.Mods.HotReload;
using Cthangover.Core.Mods.Unload;
using Cthangover.Core.Utils;
using Godot;

/// <summary>Triggers the real mod unloader on a separate frame while the MCP caller waits.</summary>
public sealed class UnloadDuringCommand : IModDevelopmentCommand
{
    private SceneTree tree;
    private JsonObject report;

    /// <summary>Exposes the test trigger and the independently observable completion result.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyCollection<string> Commands { get; } = new[] { "test.debug.unload_during_call", "test.debug.unload_result" };

    /// <summary>Explains how the fixture separates the outstanding call from its unload observation.</summary>
    public string Description => "Schedules a bridge unload during a cancellable call. Query test.debug.unload_result independently afterward.";

    /// <summary>Waits for cancellation without blocking the game thread that performs the unload.</summary>
    public async Task<JsonNode> ExecuteAsync(ModDevelopmentContext context, string command, CancellationToken token)
    {
        if (command == "test.debug.unload_result")
            return report;
        if (!GameEnvironment.IsRuntime)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("This fixture needs a running scene tree.");

        tree = context.Tree;
        tree.CreateTimer(0.1).Timeout += UnloadBridge;
        await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15), token);
        return JsonValue.Create(false);
    }

    private async void UnloadBridge()
    {
        var ticket = ModUnloader.Unload(new[] { "debug_client" }, tree);
        var alive = await ticket.CollectAsync(tree);
        report = new JsonObject
        {
            ["released"] = JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(ticket.ModIds),
            ["alive"] = JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(alive)
        };
    }
}
